title: An affine refinement of a weakly etale algebra
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $B$ be a weakly etale $A$-algebra
[def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Put $C=C_A$, with its $A$-algebra structure,
as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover]. Its spectrum is w-local by
[lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover], so its closed points form a closed subset
by [def-weil-pbc-w-local]. Let
$$
 J=\bigcap_{\mathfrak m\in\operatorname{MaxSpec}C}\mathfrak m
$$
where $\operatorname{MaxSpec}C$ denotes the set of maximal ideals of $C$;
this is the radical ideal defining the closed-point subset. Define
$$
 D_0=B\otimes_A C,\qquad K=JD_0,\qquad
 B'=(D_0)_{[V(K)]},
$$
where $K$ is the ideal generated by the image of $J$ under
$c\mapsto 1\otimes c$, and the last operation is the retained localization
of [def-weil-pbc-retained-localization]. Equip $B'$ with the $B$- and
$C$-algebra structures induced by $b\mapsto b\otimes 1$ and
$c\mapsto 1\otimes c$ followed by the canonical map $D_0\to B'$.
